collector.note: shakedown corpus: one repetition per request, no /tokenize ground truth, request and response bodies as the recorder serialised them (parsed JSON, not raw bytes), no engine image digest. recipe_file_sha256 is the recipe file's hash when the corpus was compacted, not at recording: the recorded run predates the recipe fixes of 2026-10-07; the recorded prompts still render from the current recipes, which tests/conformance/test_recipe_sources.py checks for the embedding requests and every conformance replay checks for the rerank pair prompts. The release corpus is re-recorded at RC0 with rcp_ndcg_vllm.observe and keyed by fingerprint.

non_determinism.rule: same-request repetitions only: exchanges whose request digest (method, path and the canonical request body) is identical are repetitions of one question; the measured value is the largest absolute and relative difference of any numeric leaf of their normalised response bodies between any two of them; the verification tolerance is the measured pair itself, each bound applying jointly; without a repetition the tolerance is unmeasured and a replay is compared exactly

provisional.not_valid_for: release evidence: no recipe is verified, no GPU-run number is reproduced from this corpus
provisional.replaced_by: the RC0 recording wave (rcp_ndcg_vllm.observe), keyed by behaviour fingerprint
provisional.valid_for: building and testing the verified fake engines (the emulators and their conformance suite)
provisional.why: recorded by the GPU shakedown (waves shake-a1/shake-a2 of 2026-10-06) with the recorder's fixed exchange set: one repetition per request, request and response bodies kept as parsed JSON (not raw bytes), no engine image digest, no /tokenize ground truth, no /pooling recording; some recipes of that shakedown were served with temporary shakedown-only patches
